channel.name: ORU R01 to FHIR Patient
channel.description: Demo oru2fhir: an ORU^R01 (POST ER7 to /patient/, port 10802) becomes a single FHIR R4 Patient resource conforming to ExampleLabPatient in /fhir-volume/ig. One FHIR Profile Mapper step; the HTTP response is the Patient.

fr.kazepoy.fhir.mapper.FhirProfileMapper.name: Patient
fr.kazepoy.fhir.mapper.FhirProfileMapper.mappings: [{"key": "Patient.identifier:ipp.value", "element": "Patient.identifier:ipp.value", "type": "string", "expression": "fhirFind(msg['PID']['PID.3'], function (cx) { return cx['PID.3.5'] == 'PI'; })['PID.3.1'].toString()", "path": [["identifier", "ipp#0"], ["value"]]}, {"key": "Patient.name", "each": "msg['PID']['PID.5']", "variable": "n", "path": [["name", "#0"]]}, {"key": "Patient.name.use", "element": "Patient.name.use", "type": "code", "expression": "({L: 'official', D: 'usual', M: 'maiden'})[n['PID.5.7'].toString()]", "path": [["name", "#0"], ["use"]]}, {"key": "Patient.name.family", "element": "Patient.name.family", "type": "string", "expression": "n['PID.5.1']['PID.5.1.1'].toString() || n['PID.5.1'].toString()", "path": [["name", "#0"], ["family"]]}, {"key": "Patient.name.given", "element": "Patient.name.given", "type": "string", "expression": "n['PID.5.2'].toString()", "path": [["name", "#0"], ["given", "#0"]]}, {"key": "Patient.name.given[1]", "element": "Patient.name.given[1]", "type": "string", "expression": "n['PID.5.3'].toString()", "path": [["name", "#0"], ["given", "#1"]]}, {"key": "Patient.gender", "element": "Patient.gender", "type": "code", "expression": "msg['PID']['PID.8']['PID.8.1'].toString()", "path": [["gender"]], "translate": {"conceptMap": "http://example.org/fhir/oru2fhir/ConceptMap/v2-0001-to-gender", "source": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0001", "target": "", "unmapped": "none", "keepSource": false}}, {"key": "Patient.birthDate", "element": "Patient.birthDate", "type": "date", "expression": "msg['PID']['PID.7']['PID.7.1'].toString()", "path": [["birthDate"]]}, {"key": "Patient.identifier:ipp.system", "element": "Patient.identifier:ipp.system", "fixed": "http://example.org/fhir/oru2fhir/sid/ipp", "when": 1, "path": [["identifier", "ipp#0"], ["system"]]}]

com.mirth.connect.plugins.javascriptstep.name: End transformation timing
